recommendation_summary: Act now by rotating approval duty among the lead and the two authorized engineers, with a named backup. The duty engineer reassigns any ready PR whose reviewer is away. The target is review within one working day, checked each morning in the existing tracker. After a week, results are compared against the six-change baseline. Squads, chapters, Jira Align and quarterly workshops are deferred, and no optional additions are offered.
note: The fix is small and well grounded, but the reply never uses the four required labels, so every record-based predicate fails.
